1.title: What We Know About the Police Shooting in Madison
1.summary: A Black man was shot and killed by the police on Wednesday, not far from the Wisconsin Capitol. An investigation is underway.

2.title: Trump vows to investigate EU over fining of US tech companies

3.title: Teen Charged in Georgia School Shooting Changes Plea to Guilty
3.summary: Colt Gray, 16, had been scheduled to go on trial in October. His change of plea took place at a hearing that pivoted immediately to sentencing.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Meets With Cabinet Over Whether to Intensify Iran Strikes
4.summary: The discussions at the White House came days before a planned meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel.  Across the region, Iran and the United States continued to trade attacks.
